newsitem.title: USA: US Midwest hogs called steady to lower for Friday.
newsitem.headline: US Midwest hogs called steady to lower for Friday.

text.p: U.S. Midwest direct cash hog prices were called mostly steady to lower Friday, with sagging pork prices overriding support from expected light hog marketings, cash dealers said.
"They don't need a lot of numbers anymore," said an Iowa hog dealer, referring to meat packers scaling back the slaughter pace because of poor operating margins.
USDA estimated Thursday's hog slaughter at 341,000 head versus 349,000 a week ago and 350,000 a year ago.
Dealers said hog producers are current on marketings and can resist lower prices by holding hogs off the market.
USDA estimated interior Iowa/southern Minnesota hog receipts at 95,000 head versus 103,000 a week ago and 99,000 a year ago.
